fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck side is an open quasi-public service road running along the building's north face. Trucks and trailers park freely along it. The fenced dock/trailer yard has chain-link gates in its fence, but there is no barrier arm or staffed checkpoint at the property entrance from S 6th St. Classed false; flagged uncertain because the operational yard is fenced.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at any entrance in 2025-08 Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Numbered dock doors observed in Street View (bays 21-24+ visible) with trailers backed in along the north/northwest building face; estimated ~26, band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A fenced trailer-storage yard sits on the building's northwest side; trailers also stage along the north service road.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main production/warehouse block plus a separate large building to the west and long covered storage canopies. Some west canopies may be a separate (non-GM) self-storage business — buildingCount flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single combined entry/exit via the north service road; lane count inferred.
